payload.unit_title: R21 Major Project Report Layout & Modular Print Templates (M2.3-IMPLEMENT-001)
payload.objective: Implement Slice 1 of M2.3: Enhance report layout shell and build the 8 modular print partials covering all 5 statutory report types under <x-layouts.report-layout>.
payload.explicit_request: Review the implementation TASK_REPORT for task 'M2.3-IMPLEMENT-001' (Slice 1: Report Layout Enhancement & Modular Print Templates). Confirm whether Slice 1 is approved and issue TASK_DISPATCH for Slice 2 (M2.3-IMPLEMENT-002: Dedicated Print Report Feature Test & Verification). Return decision: 'TASK_DISPATCH' with payload.task_dispatch.

task_report.summary: Slice 1 completed. 8 modular print partials created extending <x-layouts.report-layout>. All 5 statutory report types implemented (group breakdown, CIA register, SBTE statement, ESE 8-rubrics, consolidated register). Reuses shared institutional header and signatures. All files < 110 lines (max 107 lines). 29 tests passed (214 assertions). User.php untouched.

tests.syntax: php -l passed across all files (0 errors)
tests.unit: php artisan test passed (29 tests, 214 assertions, 0 failures)

payload.reason: M2.3 Slice 1 is approved to proceed to dedicated verification. The implementation remains within the approved 10-file whitelist, preserves the existing x-layouts.report-layout as the single print master shell, decomposes the 1,025-line legacy report into modular sub-500-line Blade files, and covers all five identified statutory report modes. The shared institutional header and signatures are correctly separated for reuse, and the controller change is narrowly scoped to request negotiation. Syntax checks and the existing R21 controller/full suite pass with zero reported regressions, while User.php and database state remain untouched. Slice 2 should now add dedicated print-report feature coverage for all five report types without expanding implementation scope or modifying the print architecture.

task_dispatch.objective: Create dedicated feature coverage for the R21 Major Project consolidated print report and verify all five statutory report modes, their report-layout integration, critical rendered content, and regression safety.
instructions: Create the dedicated feature test at carmel-linx-laravel/tests/Feature/R21MajorProjectPrintReportTest.php.
Test all five report modes: group_breakdown, cia_register, sbte_submission, ese_rubrics, and consolidated.
For each mode, verify the expected HTTP response behavior, report title/content, shared institutional header, relevant statutory data/content, and signatures where applicable.
Verify that the rendered report uses the existing x-layouts.report-layout rather than introducing or expecting a duplicate print shell.
Verify representative report-specific fields and data bindings sufficient to detect accidental omission of the migrated legacy functionality.
Keep the test deterministic and aligned with the existing R21 test conventions and available test fixtures/factories.

Do not alter the Slice 1 implementation unless the dedicated tests expose a concrete defect. If a defect requires files outside the approved Slice 2 scope, stop and report it rather than expanding scope autonomously.
Run the dedicated print-report test, the existing R21MajorProjectControllerTest, and the full application test suite.
Return a TASK_REPORT only. Do not commit or modify migration control-plane state.
constraints: Do not modify User.php, migrations, database schema, routes, STATE.json, FEATURE_MATRIX.md, or unrelated application files.
Do not create or modify any duplicate shell or x-ui component.
Do not change the approved M2.3 Slice 1 architecture merely to make tests pass.
Do not execute destructive database operations or migrations.
Do not begin M2.4 or any other migration unit.
Do not commit changes; checkpoint authorization will be issued separately.
task_dispatch.expected_report: A TASK_REPORT containing the exact test file created, test coverage for all five report modes, assertions made for HTTP/rendered content/layout integration, dedicated test results, existing controller test results, full-suite results, any discovered defects or ambiguities, whitelist compliance, and git status.
stop_conditions: Stop if the required test cannot be implemented without modifying files outside the approved scope.
Stop if a concrete Slice 1 defect is discovered that requires implementation changes; report it for architect review instead of expanding scope.
Stop after dedicated verification is complete.
Do not modify migration state or commit.
Return only the TASK_REPORT for architect review.
